milestones.title: 0.75.0 — reliability & enforcement
milestones.summary: The owner's four verbatim asks shipped together: the transient-API retry ladder (immediate → 1.5m → 5m → 10m → 30m → stop+notify, visible status card), hard task-mode enforcement (plan/review/explore read-only at the toolset level, owner-pinned, debug command tier, delegation inheritance), hover-only mode descriptions + read-only badges, and the single-row composer toolbar with the actually-working 5-line textarea. The deepest find: SDK error PARTS were swallowed — real 429s could never classify nor ladder; the adapter now re-throws them (live-verified).

milestones.title: R76 — the documentation round
milestones.summary: Docs caught up with the code: the session history backfilled R68-R75 (8 entries, +147 lines), five AGENT-MEMORY lessons recorded (72-76), the two R75 ADRs written (0026 task-mode policy, 0027 retry-ladder), ARCHITECTURE/IMPLEMENTED-API/EXTENSIBILITY/DESIGN-SYSTEM/ROADMAP/SECURITY/HANDOFF corrected to the shipped truth, the docs index completed (5 unindexed runbooks), and the stamp-cohort rule documented where the next agent will find it (DOC-STANDARDS §8 + MAINTENANCE recipe g). milestones.title: R77 — the field-report round
milestones.summary: The 0.75.0 field report addressed end-to-end: the composer split left/right with the send action locked to its cluster, the model pill's Cpu icon, the redesigned retry card, the vanish-on-failure fix (freezeFailedTurn keeps the error card + the user's message), envelope-intact API errors + full-text error cards, revert-as-edit-and-resend (inclusive truncation + composer refill), and a live real-provider E2E battery including a genuine rate-limit storm that exercised the retry ladder live.

milestones.title: R78 — the honest-errors + queue round
milestones.summary: The owner’s four verbatim asks shipped together: the error chain robustified (RetryError unwrapped so classification reads the real status; a 403 region block no longer lies ‘authentication failed’; userMessage is the API’s REAL text — only a real rate limit ladders, every other failure shows the provider’s actual words on the live retry card too), the composer’s action group restructured into a never-wrapping bottom-right anchor (Continue/Send/Stop/queue-send can never render in a wrong position), the Settings → General retry config (three per-class auto-retry switches — a disabled class fails fast with the real text), and the message queue (send while the agent works — the message queues as an amber chip, auto-delivers after the current tool call with full context, continues the same stream at turn end, survives stops/crashes via the pre-flip). Verified: 2708 tests (agent-core 1742), the battery-r78 live battery 12/12 (real 429 ladder + a mock-provider request-body oracle), browser-verified on the real dev stack.

current.title: R78 — the honest-errors + queue round (retry honesty, composer anchor, retry settings, message queue)
current.detail: The owner’s four verbatim asks, every one implemented + unit-tested + live-battery-verified (12/12) + browser-verified: (1) ERROR-CHAIN HONESTY — the AI SDK’s RetryError is now unwrapped before classification (extractStatus walks lastError/errors, depth ≤ 4), so a wrapped 429 classifies by status instead of message-pattern luck; a 403 whose body says region/moderation/permission/unavailable reclassifies to fail-fast unknown carrying the REAL text (a region block no longer claims ‘authentication failed’); userMessage/classMessage are the provider’s REAL words (240-char cap, generic lines demoted to the empty fallback) and providerError rides every meta.retry frame + the 502 envelope + the persisted turn.error — the live RetryStatusCard shows the class chip + the API’s actual text (mono, 3-line clamp, the R77 expand toggle); (2) THE COMPOSER ACTION ANCHOR — the toolbar is a wrapping area (left cluster + ml-auto selectors) plus a never-wrapping shrink-0 sibling anchor (data-composer-actions) holding Continue/Send/Stop/queue-send pinned bottom-right by justify-between — the action button can never jump lines (verified stable at 386/480/560/641/900 px); (3) RETRY SETTINGS — RetrySettings {autoRetryRateLimit, autoRetryTimeout, autoRetryNetwork} (default all true) behind GET/PUT /settings/retry, the ladder gated per class in both turn paths (a disabled class fails fast: attempts 1, real text), rendered as the Auto-retry card on the Settings tab now LABELED General (URL id ‘advanced’ unchanged); (4) THE MESSAGE QUEUE — a session_events row of new type message.queued (the exact message.user payload; delivery is a strict type flip so the message lands where it was queued), three delivery paths (loop-top flip before assembleHistory — the model reads it with the completed tool results; the turn-end same-stream continuation loop consuming the first + flipping the rest, meta.queue_continue, capped at 25; the pre-flip crash/stop recovery before the next send’s user event), POST /sessions/:id/queue (+ user.queued frame on the open stream via the turn registry’s notify hook) + DELETE /sessions/:id/queue/:seq, and the frontend (queue-send beside Stop, amber chips with X-remove/Send-now, delivered messages as user bubbles, the queued fold item). Root 2708/2708 in 144 files (agent-core 1742, frontend 954, e2e 12); the battery-r78 live battery + browser verification on the real dev stack.
